MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='THETA', seasonality_champion='NaiveMovingAverage', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: THETA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) matching y_true's downward trend, while NaiveMovingAverage leads seasonality capture (0.417 correlation). ETS wins overall RMSE (27.92) but the series is highly unpredictable (spectral entropy 0.941) with unstable rankings (Kendall τ=-0.29) and redundant models (ARIMA-ETS correlation 0.9999). Given concept drift and high model disagreement, robust median/trimmed_mean combinations are preferred over weighted stacking to avoid overfitting noise.
